intro: A data analyst whose bullets end in decisions: each analysis is tied to what the business did with it, which is what hiring managers look for.
tips: Show the decision your analysis informed, not just the dashboard you built.
Name the tools once, in skills; in experience, talk about questions and answers.
Quantify the money, time or customers affected.

basics.name: Grace Okafor
basics.label: Data Analyst
basics.summary: Data analyst with four years in retail and subscription businesses, fluent in SQL, Python and Tableau. Built the churn model that guided a retention programme saving £1.4m a year.

work.name: Parcel & Co
highlights: Built a churn model in Python that flagged at-risk subscribers; the retention offers it guided saved £1.4m in a year.
Replaced 30 weekly spreadsheets with three Tableau dashboards used by the leadership team.
Ran pricing experiments on 40,000 customers that settled a £5 price rise without lifting churn.

work.name: Highstreet Retail Group
highlights: Wrote the SQL behind weekly store performance reports for 120 managers.
Found £200k of annual waste in overstocked sizes, changing how stores were allocated stock.
